parameters.content:
## Campaign API
Authenticated actions for campaigns, templates, statistics, replies, controls and JSON contact imports. Each incoming webhook starts its own independent execution.

## Contact Imports
CSV/XLSX import with row validation, normalization and duplicates. Supabase rejects suppressed phones. This branch never sends messages.

## WASender Events
Verify X-Webhook-Signature, sanitize and persist events. STOP and unsubscribe suppress immediately before responding. Scheduled branch applies delivery/read/reply updates.

## Scheduled Worker
One 15-second scheduler: recover expired leases, process statuses/replies, claim one due message and send. Supabase retains intervals, timezone windows, retries and progress. Unknown outcomes require review.

## Manual Validation and Supabase Setup
Manual Setup and Validation runs 12 safe checks only. Create tables and RPC functions once by running supabase-setup.sql in Supabase SQL Editor. Project URL and API key authorize runtime requests; they cannot install arbitrary SQL. The old direct-database installer has been removed.

## START HERE — SUPABASE API
ONE WORKFLOW, no Postgres connection nodes. Set the project URL once in Supabase API Configuration. Select your Supabase API credential (Host = project URL, Secret Key = backend key) on the eight Supabase HTTP nodes. Run supabase-setup.sql once in Supabase SQL Editor. Add WASender and webhook/API authentication credentials later. Keep inactive until authorized tests pass. No database host, port, username or password is used by this workflow.
